content.introduction: GDP, CPI, and other key economic reports are available on Bankrate and the Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) platform. FRED provides extensive historical economic data and current releases.
body: Bankrate.com displays the US gross domestic product GDP, consumer price index CPI, housing starts, and the unemployment rates for consumers.
Bankrate.com provides weekly and historical consumer price index data and other key economic indicators.
